spans.s:
ind.
An interjection of calling to a low female: see हण्डे.

f. (-का)
An earthen pot or boiler; also हण्डी.

m. (-तः)
A small earthen pot.
E.
हण्डिका an earthen pot, and सुत son.

ind.
A vocative particle to be addressed in theatrical language to a female of inferior rank.
E.
हिडि to treat with contempt or disrespect, aff. ए, and the form irr.; also with आ, aff. हण्डा.
